title: Prove a rank-four cube parity obstruction (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Give an explicit saturated rank-four lattice in Z^10 whose cube vectors span it over Q but miss one direction modulo two. This is a scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. No new kappa is claimed.

```text
full lattice:          binary rank 4
its eight cube vectors: binary rank 3, integral-span index 2
missing coset:         minimum maximum-coordinate magnitude 2
```

The package `research/rank-four-cube-parity/` contains the proof, standalone verifier and source/replay metadata. The proof determines the entire lattice and every cube vector. This gives a concrete failure of an unrestricted extension of the BIT cube-parity reduction beyond relation rank three.

Credit Ali Romman for the existing rank-three parity-basis argument, CubeJerry for the arbitrary-register saturation question and two-relation continuation, and the eumemic/David Govea/woklerx relation-framework lineage. The initial proposed rank-three lemma was already on main; the [scope update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19441252) records the change to this original rank-four counterexample. No predecessor result is audited or replayed.

## Evidence

Before this contribution, the cited low-rank argument supplied a parity-spanning cube basis at relation rank three. The new example shows that rational cube generation alone is insufficient at rank four.

Local CPython 3.12.15 warning-strict development-mode checks pass in normal and optimized modes, with identical output. Each emits `PASS_RANK_FOUR_CUBE_PARITY`. They enumerate all 59,049 ambient cube vectors, finding exactly eight nonzero lattice members; both sets of 210 maximal minors; a separate 6,561-point coefficient box; and eight explicit sign-column omission controls. The missing-coset height-two lower bound rests on the written all-coordinate norm identity, with an attaining vector.

The two registered checks took 0.244 and 0.256 seconds locally, measured only to check the replay budget. The package runner emits `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. Metadata/pins, committed bytes and declared source history pass at `b845894ac5945d4c0ef16da457d2dceb1dd739a2`. A generated local receipt binds all six package-file hashes and the interpreter environment.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -B -W error -X dev research/rank-four-cube-parity/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -B -W error -X dev research/rank-four-cube-parity/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank-four-cube-parity
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/rank-four-cube-parity --check-source-history
```

Any CPython 3.12 executable can replace this installation path. The standalone verifier uses only the standard library and requires no Git, network or predecessor imports.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The claim is an abstract relation-lattice obstruction. No realization of the ten quotient generators by rational rank-one matrix frames, scalar projector endpoint identity, legal native word, dirty restoration or complete target/paid bill is supplied. The example does not settle the eight-call span-five problem, whose relation rank is three. Minimal ambient dimension is unknown.

No selected scientific replay, supplier admission, proof-kernel check or independent human review is claimed. The selected conditional kappa remains 0.003125804 and all five framework assumptions remain. The initial selected-baseline command was source-binding orientation only. Canonical main was refreshed at `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` before submission. Overlap searches cover live open PR/Discussion records and all main research README files, with their stated sparse-local and historical-search limits.

## Open next questions

- What is the smallest ambient dimension admitting a rank-four cube-parity defect? Start with exact cube intersections in dimensions five through nine; no ambient-dimension minimality proof is supplied.
- Can such a defect be realized by rational rank-one matrix frames in a legal BIT word? Start with the rank-six quotient generators and rank-one minor equations. Endpoint, native and complete invoice obligations remain separate.

## Related open work

- #6777 proves the arbitrary-width two-relation word bound and raises saturation in its continuation. This contribution gives a rank-four lattice obstruction and does not settle its rank-three word case.
- #6782 bounds three-dimensional binary pattern pools and excludes a specified five-type word. This contribution concerns the earlier relation-lattice parity reduction and supplies no projector-word exclusion.
- #6785 excludes irreducible five-dimensional one-edge pattern pools. This lattice example has no scalar projector pool and compares none of its joint-image counts.

The post-CI related-work refresh read the other open account PRs created since the advance claim: #6795, #6796, #6797, #6799, #6800, #6801, #6802. None studies the same cube relation lattice, cube intersection or parity-rank quantity, so no additional numerical comparison is required.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at `b845894ac5945d4c0ef16da457d2dceb1dd739a2`: `plan` and `replay (research/rank-four-cube-parity)`, in [run 42228465356](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42228465356). The completed checks were read once and confirmed. The hosted replay certifies both registered normal and optimized finite checks. Local direct/registered checks, metadata/pins, committed bytes and declared source history also passed. The written lattice proof remains distinct from finite replay and formal proof-kernel acceptance. No check failed or remains pending.
